text: dsh-ask-user-timeout 是适用于 DSH Web 的守护插件，为模型调用的 ask_user_question 设置有界等待时间。它在 tools/execute 执行钩子中仅包装该提问工具，默认等待 10 分钟，也可通过 timeoutMs 调整；超时后返回带 ASK_TIMEOUT 标记的结构化结果，让运行循环继续处理，而其他工具和上游取消保持原有结果。适合使用 DSH Web、遇到提问无人显示或长期无响应的用户。安装从 GitHub 仓库添加插件；代码未显示需要 API 密钥或运行时外部服务。

dsh-ask-user-timeout adds a bounded wait to DSH Web ask_user_question calls. The default is 10 minutes, configurable with timeoutMs. On timeout it returns ASK_TIMEOUT; other tools pass through. Install from GitHub. Runtime code shows no API key or external service requirement.
DSH 提问没人看到时，能不能过一段时间自动结束等待？
想给 ask_user_question 设置最长等待时间，避免会话一直转圈。
How can I stop an unanswered DSH question from keeping the agent loop waiting forever?
dsh-ask-user-timeout 的功能「提问等待超时」：ask_user_question 默认等待 10 分钟，可通过 timeoutMs 调整。超时返回带 ASK_TIMEOUT 的结构化结果，其他工具和上游取消保持原结果。

dsh-ask-user-timeout README · dsh-ask-user-timeout：Guard plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): gives the model-facing `ask_user_question` tool a **bounded lifetime**, so a question that no browser tab renders cannot hang the agent loop forever.

dsh-ask-user-timeout README · The bug this fixes：When the model calls `ask_user_question`, the tool call parks the loop until a human answers in the Web UI. The question is rendered **only** by the live browser composer takeover (`ui-user-questions`). If no tab is actively showing that session — tab closed, backgrounded overnight, mux connection dropped — nothing renders the question, and **nothing ever times it out**:

dsh-ask-user-timeout README · The bug this fixes：- the turn stays "in progress" indefinitely (no timeout, no re-notification, no visible error);
- the only exit is a manual stop, which surfaces a misleading `ASK_ABORTED` ("aborted before the user answered") even though the question was never shown to anyone.

dsh-ask-user-timeout README · The bug this fixes：This plugin wraps `ask_user_question`'s execution with a cooperative deadline (the same `deadline()` primitive the shipped `timeout-policy` guard uses). When the deadline wins, the tool returns a structured, model-visible **`ASK_TIMEOUT`** result instead of hanging forever — the loop moves on and the model can re-ask or proceed.

dsh-ask-user-timeout README · How it works：- Listens on `tools/execute` (same extension point as the official `timeout-policy` guard).
- Only wraps tools named `ask_user_question`; everything else delegates unchanged.
- Swaps `exec.signal` for the fused deadline during dispatch, restores the upstream signal afterwards.
- On timeout, substitutes a result with `error.code = ASK_TIMEOUT`; a nested/upstream deadline reads as an ordinary cancel and passes through untouched.
- Does **not** change the tool's schema, output shape, or semantics.

dsh-ask-user-timeout README · Scope：This is a guard plugin, not a fix to the Web UI rendering gap. It stops the *hang*; the deeper issue (a question nobody renders is never re-notified on tab return / reconnect) is tracked upstream in [deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness discussion #2929](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/2929).
